# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release (the current `main` branch) receives security fixes.

| Version        | Supported |
| -------------- | --------- |
| Latest release | Yes       |
| Older releases | No        |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.

Report it privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:
[open a draft security advisory](https://github.com/tlamDson/TravelPlan/security/advisories/new)
(repository **Security** tab → **Report a vulnerability**).

Include the affected area, steps to reproduce, and the impact you expect. You
will get a reply on the advisory; once a fix is released, the advisory is
published with credit to you unless you prefer otherwise.
